resources.name: Zeo++
resources.notes: Open-source geometric pore analysis software; used for computing PLD, LCD, surface areas, volumes, and void fractions.

resources.name: RASPA
resources.notes: Open-source molecular simulation code for GCMC and Widom insertion. Force-field parameters (Dreiding+UFF for framework; Hirschfelder for Xe, Talu–Myers for Kr) are standard and implemented within the simulation input.

resources.name: MFM crystal structures
resources.notes: CIF files for MFM-126, MFM-127, MFM-128, MFM-136, MFM-137, MFM-138 are included in the Supplementary Information of Humby et al., Chem. Sci., 2019. These are the only external input needed for both Zeo++ and RASPA steps.
